SALAH_WIDGET / CP7.5 / OFFLINE PHYSICAL REFERENCE

A registered sky, tested in motion.

Real catalogue stars and corrected Gaia/Hipparcos integrated starlight share one observer, one atmospheric path and one display transform. Rendering runs in a worker where available; only the latest accepted frame is shown. This remains a CPU reference, not the joined prayer widget.

Observer and sky

Component views retain the combined frame's exposure. There is no independent diffuse brightness boost.
Atmosphere and night budget
Residual = an explicit assumption, not measured airglow. It replaces CP6's aggregate night floor while diffuse is enabled. Conditions are prescribed tests, not weather observations.
Display and sampling
Asset resilience drillsFailures must show a fresh CP6 fallback, not an older diffuse frame. Restore normal assets to recover.

Source: Gaia DR3 / ESA Gaia DPAC and Hipparcos, aggregated by Rener Castro / astrogo; corrected and registered in CP7.3. Full BVRI input, provenance and licences are retained in the archive. Runtime diffuse light is V-only: effective in-band atmospheric transmission assumes the retained Vega weighting; colour is a neutral V-equivalent proxy, not a measured spectrum. Local estimates replace masked catalogue-emitter cells and remain identifiable. The residual night floor and local conditions are assumed. CP6 solar/twilight/lunar models and their limitations remain; no full multiple scattering or diffuse in-scattering is added. Exposure and the optical response are display models. Sun/Moon rings are annotations, not material discs. Source masks are a diagnostic overlay, never astronomical light.
